Open Knowledge Explorer documentation 📑

Last updated: 04 September 2026

Overview

Open knowledge explorer is a python pipeline for finding relations between concepts. It processes sentences from full open access papers into sentence embeddings for knowledge exploration with valid references to papers - making given findings traceable. Please find the github page containing the code over here and check out this extensive documentation page.
